name: Mertyn's Revenant
description: The ghostly version of Mertyn that visits the shelter each night and invites students to go with him to the lake alone.

description_citations.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Down to the Lake, Alone
description_citations.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Down to the Lake, Alone" by Isaac Fellman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Dina tells her students Mertyn's revenant will appear that night and not to go with him to the lake alone.
timeline.quote: "Don't go with him to the lake, alone."

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Down to the Lake, Alone
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Down to the Lake, Alone" by Isaac Fellman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Mertyn's revenant knocks and Lorenin answers; Mertyn invites him to the lake, and Lorenin refuses and closes the door.
timeline.quote: "Good night," said Lorenin, and closed the door.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Down to the Lake, Alone
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Down to the Lake, Alone" by Isaac Fellman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: The next night Mertyn visits Morphia, embraces her and whispers an invitation, and she throws him off.
timeline.quote: They held each other tightly, then Mertyn whispered something into her ear

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Down to the Lake, Alone
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Down to the Lake, Alone" by Isaac Fellman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: On the third night Basil goes with Mertyn's revenant to the lake and Dina and the others follow.
timeline.quote: Then Mertyn held out a hand gloved in thin leather, and Basil took it

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Down to the Lake, Alone
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Down to the Lake, Alone" by Isaac Fellman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: The Devotion rises from the lake and attacks, and Mertyn's revenant vanishes once he is no longer needed.
timeline.quote: left behind a vast watery form, a vaguely human shape with a mossy skull buried in its head.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Down to the Lake, Alone
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Down to the Lake, Alone" by Isaac Fellman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2026.

relations.note: The Devotion uses Mertyn's revenant as a lure to draw grieving students to the lake.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Down to the Lake, Alone
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Down to the Lake, Alone" by Isaac Fellman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2026.
